top.why: INVERSION on USDCx: supply Zest V2 1.38% vs borrow Granite 1.19%
top.text:
USDCx is inverted across venues.

Supplying at Zest V2 pays 1.38%. Borrowing the same asset at Granite costs 1.19%.

+19 bps, before fees, gas and liquidation risk.

sbor.xyz
